description: Source code implementing RISC-V CPU extension detection for Linux, including syscall interactions and hardware capability checks.

methods.name: doinit
methods.description: Initializes CPU feature flags by invoking the riscv_hwprobe syscall and falling back to HWCAP checks.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature bit is set in the hardware capability value.

methods.name: riscvHWProbe
methods.description: Performs the riscv_hwprobe syscall to detect supported RISC-V extensions.
